claims.description: Text generated by `::before` and `::after` contributes to intrinsic text size and block flow.

notes.text: Parity covers generated strings and attribute content affecting intrinsic width, height, and following block placement.
Inline generated content contributes to its originating element's text measurement; non-inline generated content uses an independent anonymous layout box.

claims.description: Non-inline generated pseudo-elements contribute independently styled anonymous boxes to normal, flex, and grid layout.

notes.text: Parity covers independent dimensions and spacing in block flow and generated items participating in flex and grid placement.
Counters, images, positioned generated boxes, pseudo-element geometry APIs, and pseudo-element hit targets are not modeled.
